rv.q: The result is the best play about British working-class life since Peter Gill's The York Realist .
This is a diamond production of a very humane play.
It’s all beautifully controlled in Dominic Cooke ’s brilliantly cast production...

cn.t: Eldridge delivers a riveting exploration of working-class British life in Essex, tracing family feuds and East End migration with authenticity and depth. Critics hail it as a fine, evocative drama that cements the playwright's range.
